symptoms: Infective endocarditis prophylaxis for dental extraction without anaesthetic

management_steps.details: 50 mg/kg (maximum dose: 2 g), 1 hour before the procedure. Repeat dose 6 hours later. Age bands: < 5 years: 750 mg; 5 to 10 years: 1500 mg; >= 10 years: 2 g.
Essential for all children with congenital or rheumatic heart lesions needing dental extraction without anaesthetic.
